reason: The ribs seem like the natural starting point for giving the whale its shape.
expectation: I expect the ribs to fit onto the keel and form the beginnings of the frame.

alternatives.reason: Preparing the brace cord also looks useful, but I would build the basic frame first.

effect: The ribs are in place, so the frame can now take its upper spar.
reaction: A straightforward start; I’m curious how the frame will be braced.
reason: The upper spar should connect and support the ribs.
expectation: I expect the spar to strengthen the basic whale frame.

alternatives.reason: The brace can be prepared now, but I prefer to complete the basic frame first.

effect: The upper spar is in place; the tail or brace can come next.
reaction: Straightforward progress, though the frame's strength hasn't been tested yet.
reason: I'll prepare the brace because keeping the frame rigid is the goal.
expectation: I expect the tensioners to attach to the cord so it can be tightened on the frame.

alternatives.reason: The tail would complete more of the whale's shape, but bracing seems more directly relevant to the goal.

effect: The adjustable braces are ready, but the tail is the only offered combination.
reaction: Preparing the braces was straightforward; I'm curious when they'll be fitted.
reason: I'll fit the tail to continue building the frame; it's the only offered action.
expectation: I expect the tail to attach to the frame and complete more of the whale's shape.

effect: The tail is attached, and the deck is now the only offered combination.
reaction: The whale is taking shape, though I’m still waiting to fit the braces.
reason: I'll add the deck to continue the frame; it's the only offered action.
expectation: I expect the slatted deck to fit onto the frame and provide a surface for the fair.

effect: The deck distributes attraction loads across the ribs, and the prepared braces can now be fitted.
reaction: The explanation of the deck's load path makes this more interesting than just adding a floor.
reason: I'll fit the braces to help the frame keep its shape; it's the only offered action.
expectation: I expect the diagonal braces to stiffen the whale frame against bending or twisting.

effect: The diagonal braces stiffened the frame, completing the goal and explaining how it resists changing shape.
reaction: It was satisfying to see the prepared braces finally used, though their purpose echoed the earlier crane chapter.

mostWorthwhile.text: Adding the deck was most worthwhile: the explanation of how it spreads loads across the ribs made the construction more meaningful than simply adding a floor.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the tail was straightforward but offered little explanation or decision-making; it was the only gameplay action available at that point.

surprise.text: The deck's role in carrying forces to several ribs changed how I understood it; I had mainly expected a surface for the fair.

arbitrary.text: Preparing the braces early felt slightly disconnected because they could not be fitted until after the tail and deck, though their eventual purpose was clear.

continue.text: I would probably continue to see how the whale frame becomes a flying fair, although this chapter's mostly sequential assembly was less engaging than its load-path explanation.
